title: VibeNova
description: VibeNovais an AI-assisted coding competition where participants use a designated chatbot and a strictly limited number of prompts to build a target implementation. The challenge tests strategic prompting, requirement understanding, debugging, and practical AI-assisted development. Participants must submit a GitHub repository and present their solution to judges. The winner is determined by functional accuracy, requirement matching, visual similarity, behaviour, presentation, and repository integrity.

title: NEBULA NEXUS
description: Nebula Nexus is a celestial-themed maze-solving challenge by the Algorithm & Programming Society (APS), NIT Rourkela, proposed for Innovision. Participants navigate through a maze while solving aptitude and logical reasoning questions at different checkpoints. They can choose from Easy, Medium, or Hard levels, each offering varying complexity and scoring. The event combines strategy, accuracy, logical thinking, and time management in an engaging competitive format.

title: Stellar Night
description: Stellar Night, the flagship event of AstroNITR during INNOVISION, is an overnight stargazing session that brings participants closer to the wonders of the night sky. Through telescope observations, participants can explore planets, stars, constellations, and other celestial objects. The event offers a unique opportunity to experience astronomy firsthand, fostering curiosity and appreciation for the cosmos under the serene night sky.

title: Cosmic Treasury
description: The Cosmic Treasury is a space-themed finance strategy game where teams manage a fictional colony with 10,000 Cosmic Credits. Over six rounds, participants trade assets, react to market decrees, use secret intelligence, negotiate, participate in an auction, make investments, and take calculated risks. The winner is the team with the highest final Cosmic Wealth, testing financial judgement, strategy, timing, information use, and risk management.

title: AetherHack
description: AetherHack is a national ideathon by INSPIRE, the Science and Research Club of NIT Rourkela. Open to college students across India, it invites original ideas in Sustainability, Robotics, Healthcare and an Open Track. Round 1 is online on Unstop with a written abstract. Ten finalists then pitch offline at Innovision before a professor panel. Winners share a ₹5,000 prize pool, enjoy three days of Innovision, and receive professor mentorship.

title: Mazehunt
description: Mazehunt is a fun, space-themed maze challenge where participants work in pairs to explore, solve clues, and complete seven different checkpoints. Each stage tests skills like observation, logical thinking, teamwork, creativity, and quick decision-making. The event turns a simple maze into a journey through space, making participants think, explore, compete, and enjoy the experience together.

title: DRM Escape
description: Cyclone Kalinga hits in three hours, the phone networks are down, and your team is running the control room. Crack codes, race across campus, and make the calls that decide who gets help first. Grab two to four friends, bring a cool head, and walk in as students. Walk out as responders.

title: Earth 404
description: EARTH 404 is a two-day environmental and sustainability competition, with School Students participating on Day 1 and College Students on Day 2. The event challenges participants to understand, analyse, and respond to real-world ecological problems through engaging challenges that test environmental awareness, critical thinking, quick decision-making, analytical skills, and solution-building. Integrating technology, sustainability, and the celestial theme of INNOVISION, EARTH 404 takes participants from identifying environmental challenges to developing practical, innovative solutions.

title: WEBCLONE MANIA
description: WebCloneMania is a timed web development competition in which participants recreate a website shown by the organisers at the beginning of the event. The goal is to reproduce its visual design, layout, responsiveness, and key interactions as closely as possible within the given time.

title: Astronaut In Distress
description: Astronaut in Distress is a two-member team challenge that simulates high-pressure space mission emergencies. Teams take on the roles of Astronaut and Mission Control, working together to solve technical problems, interpret mission instructions, and complete hands-on tasks. With communication challenges, time pressure, and unexpected obstacles, participants must demonstrate teamwork, quick thinking, technical knowledge, and precise coordination to successfully complete their mission.

title: Dead Man's Switch
description:
Each team consists of 2 or 3 participants. At the beginning of the event, the team will be randomly given a physical challenge. The selected participant will be designated as the “Dead Man” and must continuously perform the assigned physical activity while the remaining team members attempt to complete two consecutive challenges.
 The two stages are:
 1. Puzzle Challenge
 2. Buzz Wire Challenge
 After successfully completing both stages, the team will receive two clues. Using these clues, the Dead Man must identify and answer the final question within a maximum of three attempts.
 The team that completes the entire challenge in the minimum time will be declared the winner.
 
 Each team must complete the entire challenge within 150 seconds ( 2 minutes and 30 seconds).

title: Innovathon
description: Innov-A-Thon 2026 is an entrepreneurship and innovation challenge organized by E-Cell as part of Innovision 2026. It encourages participants to think creatively, solve real-world problems, and develop impactful ideas. The event focuses on innovation, problem-solving, and entrepreneurial thinking, providing participants with a platform to transform bold ideas into practical solutions and meaningful impact.

title: OMEGA
description:
Omega: The Ultimate Treasure Hunt" is a thrilling adventurous event
 where logic, strategy and mathematical prowess are your keys to
 uncovering hidden treasures. In this event, participants will form teams
 and set out on a campus-wide hunt, following clues, solving puzzles, and
 cracking codes that lead to the ultimate prize. Each step of the way, they
 will encounter challenges that test their problem-solving abilities,
 creativity, and teamwork. The clues are designed to push their
 mathematical limits while keeping the excitement high.

title: Case Carnival 2.0
description: National-level case competition with an online Round 1 and a one-day offline final.

title: Interstellar
description: Interstellar is a scientific problem-solving and chemical engineering team competition where participants tackle survival challenges across alien planets. Teams of 2–3 members are provided with different planets, their abundant elements, and a specific inventory of available elements. Using chemical reactions and valid equations, teams must design effective survival strategies. Their solutions are evaluated based on chemical accuracy, strategic viability, and overall effectiveness.

title: FINAL FRONTIER
description: Final Frontier is an action-packed Business Bulletin Club event designed to test business instinct, creativity, negotiation, and reflexes. Participants will compete across three engaging activities: 30-Minute CEO, featuring rapid-fire business challenges; Barter Boss, where participants create value through strategic trading; and Bottle Grab, testing speed and reflexes. With fast-paced challenges, competitive energy, and exciting prizes, the event transforms business skills into an interactive campus experience.

title: NOVAGRID
description: Mission NovaGrid is an interactive space-themed strategy game where players must find a new habitable planet after their home planet is destroyed. With limited fuel and credits, every route and decision matters. Players solve challenges, manage resources, and test different planets while adapting to unexpected outcomes. Designed for individuals or teams, the game combines strategy, problem-solving, and suspense in an engaging 15–20 minute experience.

title: LITTLE SCIENCE YARD
description: Little Science Yard (LSY) is AASRA’s annual flagship science exhibition designed to ignite curiosity and creative thinking among underprivileged students across various sectors. The event brings young minds together to showcase innovative working models and science projects at NIT Rourkela. Through interactive demonstrations, hands-on learning, and mentorship, LSY offers these students a unique platform to explore scientific concepts, build confidence, and present their ideas to an audience.

title: CYCLOTHON 5.0
description: Cyclothon 2026 is a cycling marathon organized by the SDG Campus Club every year as part of INNOVISION Fest. The event aims to promote sustainable transportation, environmental awareness, physical fitness, and active participation in building a healthier and more sustainable future. Participants take 2 rounds of the entire campus starting from Jagda Gate, covering a total of 17 checkpoints, corresponding to the 17 Sustainable Development Goals given by the United Nations.

title: Design Dash
description: Design Dash is a fast-paced, four-stage design competition that challenges creativity, observation, problem-solving, and teamwork. Participants will race through activities including finding colour matches, navigating a design maze, solving scribble-based challenges, and building paper planes. Each round tests a different design skill, while speed and accuracy add to the excitement. The team with the best overall performance will emerge as the winner.

title: Cosmic Brawl
description: Cosmic Brawl is an action-packed gaming event bringing together immersive VR combat and high-speed racing under one roof. Participants can step into the arena with Cosmic Brawl VR, battling opponents in an exciting virtual experience, or take on Veloche V2, testing their speed, precision, and racing skills. Get ready for an adrenaline-filled gaming experience!

title: Virtual racing competition
description:
The Virtual Racing Championship offers participants an immersive, high-fidelity motorsport
 driving experience. Utilizing professional-grade simulator hardware and software, the event
 replicates real-world Formula-style racing dynamics. Participants navigate technical virtual
 circuits, competing for the fastest lap time on a live updated leaderboard.

title: Intelligent Trader 12.0
description: A fun trading event, where participants predict hardships and their solutions to navigate their path through a series of challenges. Participants participate strategically in an auction round, followed by multiple trading rounds to ultimately gather enough ammunition to successfully complete all missions and their journey, while spending their money carefully.

title: Roadies: The Food Saga 4.0
description:
In Innovision 2026, our club FTS will be hosting an event
 titled Roadies: The Food Saga 4.0. The event will
 consist of three exciting rounds designed to showcase our
 passion for Food Technology while blending it with fun
 and creativity.
 Round-1
 In the first round, participants will be grouped as per the
 set limit and provided with a Dalgona cookie. They will
 be required to carve it into a specific shape within a given
 time limit.
 Round-2
 Participants who fail to complete the task will be
 eliminated and will not qualify for the second round,
 which will feature a rapid-fire quiz on topics related to
 food safety, nutrition, and technology. 
 Round-3
 The final round will feature blindfolded participants who
 must identify different food items using their senses. This
 round highlights the importance of sensory analysis in
 making food more appealing to consumers.

title: Circuit Heist
description: Circuit Heist is a two-day, team-based technical challenge where participants have to recover a sabotaged electronic system. Instead of solving five independent questions, they progress through a connected chain of challenges. They first decode a digital clue, then debug an electronic circuit, solve a logic lock, analyze a timing waveform and finally complete a Verilog RTL challenge. Every successful stage gives them a key to access the next one. Hints and wrong submissions carry time penalties, so both technical ability and strategy matter. The final recovered keys lead to a system-recovery code, and teams are ranked based on their effective completion time.

title: VELOCITY VORTEX
description: The Velocity Vortex competition challenges teams to race flying vehicles through an obstacle course, with the primary goal of achieving the fastest lap time. Teams get a brief 5-minute preparation period before the race starts, and once that time is up, no physical intervention with the vehicle is allowed. For a chance at extra points, vehicles can optionally pick up a provided ferromagnetic (steel) washer payload before the course and deliver it to the staging area afterward. The final score is calculated from the vehicle's lap ranking combined with any earned payload points. The teams with the highest overall scores will advance to a semi-final round, and the top five of those teams will then compete in the final race.

title: Car Show
description: The Car Show is an interactive automotive exhibition and engineering showcase organized by Team Black Mamba Racing Electric during INNOVISION. The event features a display of student-designed competition vehicles, allowing attendees to closely examine key subsystems such as the chassis, suspension, powertrain, and electrical architectures while engaging with team members. Additionally, the vehicles of SAE NIT Rourkela will be running in the campus, providing live demonstrations of their performance and engineering capabilities

title: REACT
description:
REACT: The IIChE Engineering Challenge is an interactive, team-based
 chemical engineering competition that goes beyond the conventional quiz
 format by combining technical knowledge, problem-solving, strategy, and
 resource management. Participants will be provided with a limited set of
 stationery, hint tokens, process cards, and other resources, which they
 must use strategically to solve a series of chemical engineering challenges
 within a fixegived time. From constructing process flows and solving
 engineering problems to making critical decisions about when to use hints
 or conserve resources, every round will test the participants’ ability to think
 efficiently under constraints. The event aims to create an engaging and
 competitive environment where participants are rewarded not only for what
 they know, but also for how effectively they apply their knowledge, manage
 limited resources, and make decisions under pressure.

title: Chem-E-Prix
description: Chem-E Prix is a contest where students design, build and operate a vehicle that uses chemical reactions to travel and stop after a specific given distance. The event provides a platform for students to apply the concepts of engineering and innovate a solution in a practical setting.

title: The Missing CEO
description: The Missing CEO is a business-focused corporate investigation and case-solving challenge where participants act as a review panel to uncover how organizational failures allowed a critical issue to remain hidden. Teams analyse fragmented information, question stakeholders, identify red flags, and connect evidence to diagnose failures in corporate governance, internal controls, reporting, and escalation mechanisms. The event tests strategic thinking, teamwork, analytical reasoning, and business decision-making

title: Spancraft
description:
SpanCraft is a bridge-building challenge where participants must design and construct a cable-stayed bridge along with its foundation under fixed material and budget constraints.
 
 Each team will receive a fixed initial budget to purchase foundation materials. Sand will be cheaper, while soil will be costlier but provide better foundation performance, forcing teams to make strategic decisions between cost and stability.
 
 For the bridge, teams will be provided with long wooden members and other specified materials. The completed bridge must satisfy the given dimensional requirements and will then be tested for its maximum load-bearing capacity.
 
 The winner will be the team that achieves the best combination of load capacity, dimensional accuracy and cost efficiency.

title: Aeroprix
description: Aeroprix is the flagship aeromodelling competition of UDAAN, the official Aeromodelling Club of NIT Rourkela. Bringing together aviation enthusiasts, innovators, and aspiring engineers from across the country, Aeroprix challenges participants to design, build, and fly high-performance radio-controlled aircraft.

title: MATERIALVERSE
description: "Material Verse" is an interactive technical challenge where participants become engineering decision-makers and select suitable materials for real-world applications. Teams must balance strength, weight, cost, corrosion and temperature resistance, manufacturability, and service conditions. Using BIS Standard Cards and relevant Indian Standards, participants identify non-compliance, respond to unexpected conditions, and defend their final material selection through technical reasoning, standards-based decisions, and cost optimisation.
